summary: Loaded-joint preflight and sampling demand passed exact hosted CI. Jointless scenes have no such callbacks; last-consumer retirement and loaded reset are qualified. Persistent-controller demand is now in independent review. Server workers, generic input/physics activation, broader actuation and performance remain open.
model: Codex coordinator with repository agents and an independent reviewer

active.title: Extending built-in activation beyond IMU Scene callbacks
active.detail: Accepted 2671fe4 passed exact hosted run 41055155796: 619 Rust, 103 tooling and 69/69 changed executable lines. Joint preflight/sampling demand, reset and cross-family retirement are qualified. The next persistent-controller candidate passed independent 200 Scene tests, Clippy and source review; its full normal commit hook is now running. Controller absence, typed activation, last-consumer teardown, reset and observer faults are covered; zero retains controller state. Generic input/physics callbacks, server workers and CPU/RSS measurements remain open.

active.title: Extending retained controller behavior beyond world hinges
active.detail: Accepted bounded control supports real C++ publishers, pause/reset/removal and native physical rates on three dynamic engines. Bounded DART planes are now accepted. The full original ApplyJointForce fixture still requires moving-parent actuation and remaining world/backend behavior; no full original-system or performance completion is claimed.

active.title: Qualifying broader motion and joint-limit domains
active.detail: Moving-parent actuation and finite limits remain open. The retained Rapier rotating-parent and first-crossing probes, plus private DART conditioning studies, are not acceptance evidence. Native larger articulations and balanced-workload accuracy/performance remain required.

active.title: Qualifying static planes and their scene lifecycle
active.detail: Accepted 7f6c7af passed exact hosted 41051460995 and the full normal hook, independent native/scene review, 608 Rust and 103 tooling checks and 116/116 changed executable lines. Centered local +Z DART planes preserve the native finite cube, ignored physical size, link frames, inherited static state, model removal and loaded reset. Other engines, normals/offsets and custom plane inertia remain explicit unsupported scope. Larger articulation and performance qualification remain open.

active.title: Close P0 reference-environment qualification
active.detail: Pinned baseline SHAs and the selected reproducible headless image exist; all 14 native repositories were built in that profile. Broader backend, renderer/GPU and language profile execution is not yet qualified. Record exact successful and unavailable profiles and their evidence; this does not require completing their Rust ports.

active.title: Close P0 native test inventory and ledger reconciliation
active.detail: The selected immutable headless listing contains 1,175 registrations, 578 gtest configurations and 4,589 expanded cases. Eleven registrations remain unqualified in the latest accepted inventory, and other profiles plus complete source-ledger reconciliation remain open. Resolve or explicitly review each remaining disposition; listings are not execution passes or Rust-port completion.

active.title: Close P0 balanced-robotics baseline measurements
active.detail: Selected headless streaming and kernel measurements exist. The representative articulated-robot, many-entity, camera/lidar native baseline, raw repeated samples/variance, complete hardware/configuration record and ratified budgets are still missing. Capture native baselines separately from later Rust speedup qualification; unavailable configurations need explicit evidence.

active.title: Starting optional Bevy offscreen rendering
active.detail: A dedicated rendering worker is implementing the first isolated renderer slice. Initial dependency and GPU qualification checks are underway for Bevy 0.20. The target is a real no-window primitive/camera render, derived f64 Z-up scene snapshots and bounded readback lifecycle. Default headless builds must remain free of renderer/GPU dependencies. No rendering, sensor parity or performance completion is claimed.
